dailyReview.headline: Metals flush, oil pops on Hormuz, Adobe buyback brightens — AI shorts still hurting
dailyReview.summary: Sharp one-day pullback in silver (-9.4%) and gold (-3%) on Apr 21 took the wind out of the metals sleeve, but the move looks technical after a multi-month run. Oil ripped 5% on Strait of Hormuz escalation — strong tailwind for the energy longs. Adobe announced a $25B buyback (Apr 21) and is base-building. AI short leg remains the principal pain point: NVDA at $202 / $4.9T cap, CRWV +48% YTD, MU near all-time highs.
risks: Silver -9.4% and gold -3% in one session (Apr 21) — SLV at $69.34, GLD at $453.84. Watch for further unwind if Iran de-escalation headlines cross.
CRWV completed another $1B of 9.75% notes (total now $2.75B); Q1 earnings May 7 — debt-funded buildout continues to push the short tape against you.
MU printing near all-time highs with traders eyeing a $480–$500 breakout; long-dated puts (2.9%) decaying into momentum.
bright_spots: Adobe $25B buyback announced Apr 21, +4% after-hours; stock $247, +1.7% on the day. Validates the 18% long.
WTI +5% to $88.80 on Apr 21 after Hormuz vessel attacks; Brent $96 — direct bid for RIG, CNE.L, USO and supportive for OKE / ET.
Uber confirmed $500M / 11.5% stake in Lucid + 35k-vehicle robotaxi commitment — long thesis (12.5%) intact at $77.49.
Hedge funds reportedly dumping NVDA into the macro/AI tug-of-war — flow context that supports the short leg even with price grinding higher.
actions_to_consider: Decide on metals adds vs. trimming after the Apr-21 flush; the YoY moves (SLV +135%, GLD +43%) leave room for further mean-reversion.
ONEOK Q1 earnings Apr 28 — choose to trim into the catalyst or hold for the dividend-growth signal.
CoreWeave Q1 prints May 7; consider rolling the long-dated puts further out or taking some short exposure off ahead of a likely beat.
Adobe buyback is open until April 2030 — sizing-up case strengthens if shares hold the $245–$250 base.

news.headline: Adobe approves new $25B stock repurchase program; shares +4% AH
news.summary: Buyback authorized through April 30, 2030. Stock at $247.12 with 1-week return +3.55%. Analyst 12-mo PT $349.29 (~+40%). Firefly AI Assistant + Anthropic partnership (Apr 15) still feeding the narrative.

news.headline: WTI crude jumps >5% to $88.80 after Strait of Hormuz vessel attacks
news.summary: US-Iran tensions escalated after attacks on commercial vessels. Brent ~$96.26. EIA forecast Brent-WTI spread peaks $15/b in April on production disruptions.

news.headline: Silver -9.4%, gold -3% in one session — sharp pullback off record highs
news.summary: SLV closed $69.34 (-7.22), GLD $453.84 (-13.79). Silver still +135% YoY, gold +43% YoY. Profit-taking after multi-month run; geopolitical de-escalation chatter cited.

news.headline: Uber confirms $500M Lucid stake + 35,000-robotaxi commitment
news.summary: Equity stake raised to ~11.5% (~37.8M shares) with a $200M option. UBER $77.49; analyst average Strong Buy, 12-mo PT $107 (~+39%).

news.headline: CoreWeave prices $1B more 9.750% senior notes; total reaches $2.75B
news.summary: Tranche priced at 102% of principal. Stock $117.43; 1-month +44%, YTD +48%, 1-year TSR +231%. Wolfe Research initiated Outperform with $150 PT. Q1 results due May 7.

news.headline: NVIDIA stuck in macro-vs-AI tug-of-war; hedge funds reportedly dumping
news.summary: NVDA $202.06 with $4.91T market cap. Marvell-Alphabet custom-AI-chip collaboration adding competitive pressure. 38-analyst average Strong Buy, 12-mo PT $266 (~+32%). FY26 revenue $215.94B (+65% YoY).

news.headline: Micron near all-time highs; HBM4 volume production for NVIDIA Vera Rubin underway
news.summary: 2026 HBM capacity fully sold under non-cancellable contracts. Traders watching $480–$500 breakout. Q2 FY26 revenue $23.9B (+196% YoY).

news.headline: Lululemon launches Mexico e-commerce site; 8 new MX stores planned
news.summary: lululemon.mx live with full apparel/footwear/accessories. Part of 15-store FY26 North America expansion. CEO Maestrini bought 3,275 shares @ $151.02 on Apr 1. Stock $169.38.

news.headline: ONEOK Q1 2026 earnings due Apr 28
news.summary: OKE +20% YTD, 4.7% yield, plans 3–4% annual dividend growth. Both OKE and ET flagged as April top picks among midstream names.

news.headline: Altria $1.06 quarterly dividend payable April 30
news.summary: Record date Mar 25, 2026. Annual $4.24 / 6.54% yield. Q1 earnings due ahead of payment.

news.headline: Stride opens 2026-27 enrollment across OR, MI, ID, CO; LMS issues linger
news.summary: Multi-state virtual school enrollment now open for next school year. 2025 LMS upgrade disruption still weighing on fall-term revenue.
